resolutions.researcher_notes:
HEADLINE SENTINEL, carried_sentinels_v2, given a verdict this pass. v2 (deepsweep-20260902) flagged a timing tension (StartYear1=2010-08 lines up with Sichuan-East/川气东送's 2010-06 Jiujiang gas arrival, not WEP2's 2011-09 Jiangxi arrival) and left it CONFIRMED-but-unresolved for a future pass to adjudicate. This pass adds four independent pieces of NEW documentary evidence, all converging on the same conclusion:

(1) EXHAUSTIVE WEP2 STRUCTURE, Jiangxi DRC provincial plan PDF (qianzhan, verified live + name_found): WEP2's ENTIRE Jiangxi footprint is stated as exactly '一干两支' (one trunk + two branches) -- the 中卫-樟树-广州 mainline section, 樟树-湘潭支干线 (=P4946), and 南昌-上海支干线 (=P4944) -- totaling 1,097km, first supplying Jiangxi gas 2011-09, fully built out 2012-04. No 'Jiujiang-Gao'an'/'九高线'/'九江-新建-高安' component is named anywhere in this structure.

(2) EXHAUSTIVE WEP2 EAST-SECTION STRUCTURE, MEE 2016 completion-acceptance notice (环验〔2016〕98号 companion notice, t20161222_369429.htm, verified live + name_found): independently confirms the same result via a different regulator document -- WEP2's East section (甘陕界~广州干线, 宁夏中卫-广东广州) comprises exactly five named components (mainline, 樟树-湘潭联络线, 广州-南宁支干线, 广州-深圳支干线, 南昌-上海支干线含嘉兴-甪直联络线), each with its own diameter/pressure/capacity spec. 九江市 (Jiujiang) appears only in the list of prefecture-level cities whose environmental bureaus monitor the completed project (i.e. the mainline physically transits Jiujiang prefecture) -- consistent with the separately-verified MEE Yangtze-crossing completion notice (t20161222_369425.htm, verified live + name_found), which describes the mainline's Yangtze River crossing landing at 江西省九江市瑞昌市码头镇 (Ruichang City, within Jiujiang prefecture), construction 2008-06 to trial operation 2011-06. This is the actual, confirmed WEP2 presence in Jiujiang prefecture: a mainline river crossing near Ruichang, NOT a distinct 'Jiujiang-Gao'an' branch. 新建/Xinjian and 高安/Gao'an appear in neither WEP2 structure document.

(3) SERVICE-AREA SPLIT, CCXI 2022 credit-rating report for 江西省天然气集团有限公司 (verified live + name_found on 西气东输二线; same document as the P4793-sourced cross_row_lead in leads_by_target.json, independently re-confirmed here): footnote 1 states Jiangxi has exactly two provincial long-distance gas operators split by source -- 天然气管道公司 (Phase I, 川气东送-sourced, 54% Jiangxi Gas Group / 46% 国家管网集团东部原油储运有限公司 JV) and 管道分公司 (Phase II, 西气东输二线-sourced, 100% Jiangxi Gas Group, formed 2016). Footnote 2 states Phase I's 42-county service area explicitly includes BOTH 九江 (Jiujiang, this row's start prefecture) AND 宜春 (Yichun, the prefecture that administers Gao'an, this row's end point) -- with 九江 named twice, including as a city already connected to the provincial network. Footnote 3 states Phase II's disjoint ~1,500km/40-county service area is 井冈山市、莲花县、永新县、大余县 etc -- Jinggangshan/Lianhua/Yongxin/Dayu, all in far southwestern Jiangxi (Ji'an/Ganzhou prefectures), nowhere near Jiujiang or Yichun/Gao'an. Both of this row's named endpoints fall inside Phase I's documented footprint and outside Phase II's.

(4) NAME/ROUTE PLAUSIBILITY: this row's own Chinese segment name (九江-新建-高安, 'Jiujiang-Xinjian-Gao'an') routes through Xinjian District, which is administratively part of Nanchang City -- i.e. the row's own name describes a corridor running from Jiujiang toward/through Nanchang before continuing to Gao'an, which is exactly the corridor of the confirmed Phase I trunk P4780 ('Jiujiang-Nanchang') extended onward. StartLocation=Lushan is independently attested as a legitimate Phase I trunk origin (shared with confirmed Phase I row P4779, 'Jiujiang-Jingdezhen', which also starts at Lushan).

VERDICT: all four lines of evidence converge -- this row is very likely a Phase I (川气东送-sourced) provincial branch that GEM has mislabeled as a WEP2 ('西气东输二线九高线') branch, following the same pattern already identified and flagged (not corrected) on sibling rows P4793 (Gao'an-Yujiang -- Yingtan/鹰潭, ALSO explicitly in CCXI's Phase I footnote-2 list, reinforcing that shard's own flag) and the P4778/P5861 Gao'an-Xinyu pair (高安-新余 is itself one of the Jiangxi DRC plan's six NAMED Phase I trunks). This is a CLASSIFICATION concern (PipelineName/FuelSource/Operator/Owner), NOT an existence or duplication question: a real Jiujiang-to-Gao'an-area gas corridor plausibly exists and is plausibly operating (see Status above), consistent with Phase I's documented 870km-plus network serving exactly this Jiujiang-Yichun corridor. NOT filing __REDUNDANCY__ against a specific PID: P4780 ('Jiujiang-Nanchang') shares this row's start area but has a different, non-Gao'an terminus, so this is not a literal same-pipe duplicate -- grepped every sibling payload and shard in this batch (P4776-P4797, P5859-P5866, P5886-P5889) and no other row names '九江-新建-高安'/'九高线'/'新建-高安' as its own segment, so there is no specific candidate PID to redundancy-pair against. Recommend Update pursue a document naming this corridor directly (a 竣工环境保护验收 filing in the jxgajc.com/江西赣安检测技术 pattern that has sourced other Phase I branches in this batch, or a 天然气管道公司 disclosure listing its individual Phase I branches by name) before changing PipelineName/FuelSource/Operator/Owner on the live sheet -- nothing in this run names '九江-新建-高安' directly, so nothing is staged as a value change here, only flagged, per standing practice (never delete a row off obscurity alone; flag classification concerns, don't silently change values).
